description: REopt API, published by NatLabRockies, offers an API service around REopt optimisation for sizing and dispatching renewable generation, conventional generation and storage. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. Licence: BSD-3-Clause, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The repository is a development API; the production web service and the REopt.jl optimisation package are distinct access choices. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support optimisation, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
